description: The team is interested in agriculture and using technology to improve farms. Its members explore coding, artificial intelligence, data analysis, and weather forecasting to solve farming challenges. The team welcomes creative, motivated members who want to collaborate and develop innovative solutions for more efficient and sustainable farming.
summary: Farmers struggle to balance their financial needs with the demands of the people. So, we decided to create an app that helps farmers make decisions about their businesses using NASA data. TerraCycle uses international information about crop characteristics, fertilizers, crop rotations, temperatures, rainfall, soil moisture and health, farmers’ preferences, and customers’ demands to assist farmers in making choices about their farms. Our app uses data from international sources to find weather patterns and soil health information that control how crops grow. Additionally, it contains strategies on how to prioritize customers and profits all the while maintaining crop safety. Moreover, the software also allows users to take pictures of their crops to receive a full data analysis on the soil health and additional information to improve their businesses. Furthermore, there is an inclusive soil test included in the app for farmers to improve nutrition and moisture of their fields. This is important to maintain a balanced economy with farmers' businesses and other agricultural and software industries in society. It is easily accessible to many businesses and independent farmers because it is accessible on multiple platforms.
details: Our app brings together research and information about water, soil conditions, crop rotation, and farmers’ preferences to help farmers make better decisions. Users can perform soil tests by taking pictures of their soil and entering test results. The app also provides weather comparisons, statistical comparisons, and farm analysis to help farmers determine which crops are best suited to their region and economic conditions. Additionally, farmers can explore different crop and fertilizer options, create and save their crop rotations, and view an overview of their rotation plans with detailed explanation on what happens if you choose this crop based on their economy and demand depending on their region. The app includes information about soil and water conservation, crop characteristics, and farmers priorities. It also offers seasonal crop calendars based on the users from one of the five regions. Finally, users can access a list of references at the end to learn more about the research and information used throughout the app. Our application was developed using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Tailwind CSS, with TanStack Start and Vite supporting the application framework and development process. We used Lovable as our development platform and integrated technologies such as Supabase, Leaflet, and Recharts. The app also incorporates NASA POWER historical climate data and Open-Meteo weather forecasts to provide farmers with useful agricultural information, weather comparisons, and data-driven insights. Our project is creative because it combines soil, water, weather, and crop information into one app to help farmers make better decisions. Our team considered factors such as soil health, rainfall paterns, temperature, extreme weather, crop rotation, fertilizer choices, and farmers’ economic needs. We wanted to create a tool that helps farmers choose suitable crops, plan ahead, and conserve natural resources.
